alpha_hit_interpretation.quantitative_explanation: 36 of the 37 Gold expectations (97.3%) show NO evidence of Provider-failure contamination in this audit's claim-level trace -- for those, 61.0317% (more precisely, their contribution to it) IS a clean algorithmic-recall estimate. Exactly 1 of 37 (TSM A301, 2.7%) is confirmed PROVIDER_FAILURE_CAUSAL for its absence of an Alpha commitment on at least one strong deterministic candidate claim. This one contaminated case is enough to measurably shift the metric: excluding it from evaluability (treating TSM's denominator as 5 instead of 6) raises the macro-average to 63.8095% -- a 2.7781 percentage-point difference. This is a real, quantified, but SMALL and BOUNDED contamination -- not large enough to explain any meaningful fraction of the 61.0317%-vs-75% gap (13.9683pp), but real enough that 61.0317% should not be treated as a perfectly clean measurement of algorithmic-only recall.
